# CreateOneToManyRequest

- Namespace: `PPDS.Dataverse.Metadata.Authoring`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Dataverse`
- Kind: Class

## Summary

Request to create a one-to-many (1:N) relationship between two Dataverse tables.
